reasoner.claim: Integrated public transit and active transportation infrastructure is the most effective approach.
evidence: IEA 2023 report: Transit systems can reduce urban transport emissions by 40%
C40 Cities: Cities with comprehensive transit systems have 30% lower per capita emissions
Lancet study: Active transport reduces emissions and improves public health
reasoner.reasoning: Public transit and active transport address both emissions and livability. While renewable energy and building efficiency are important, transportation is the largest single source of urban emissions. Integrated systems that combine rail, bus, cycling, and walking create modal shifts that are difficult to reverse.
